local lp = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer

local function okay(character)
	task.spawn(function()
		local humanoid = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid", 10)
		if not humanoid then return end
		local stats = humanoid:WaitForChild("StaminaStats", 10)
		if not stats then return end
		while character and character.Parent and stats.Parent do
			local ms = stats:GetAttribute("MaxStamina") or 100
			stats:SetAttribute("Stamina", ms)
			task.wait(0.1)
		end
	end)
end

if lp.Character then
	okay(lp.Character)
end

print("fpe sucks")

lp.CharacterAdded:Connect(okay)

scripts.title: Smart AutoBlock
scripts.script:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local character = player.Character or player.CharacterAdded:Wait()
local humanoidRootPart = character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")

local detentoin = 25
local enabled = true
local connection = nil

local lastPressTime = 0
local COOLDOWN = 1.3

local function pressQ()
    local currentTime = tick()
    
    if currentTime - lastPressTime < COOLDOWN then
        return
    end
    
    local virtualInputManager = game:GetService("VirtualInputManager")
    virtualInputManager:SendKeyEvent(true, Enum.KeyCode.Q, false, game)
    virtualInputManager:SendKeyEvent(false, Enum.KeyCode.Q, false, game)
    
    lastPressTime = currentTime
end

local function checkSoundPlaying(sound)
    if not sound then return false end
    if sound:IsA("Sound") then
        if sound.IsLoaded and sound.TimeLength > 0 then
            return sound.TimePosition > 0 and sound.TimePosition < sound.TimeLength
        end
        return sound.Playing
    end
    return false
end

local function checkForSwing()
    if not character or not humanoidRootPart then return end
    
    local myPosition = humanoidRootPart.Position
    local teachersFolder = Workspace:FindFirstChild("Teachers")
    if not teachersFolder then return end
    
    for _, teacher in pairs(teachersFolder:GetChildren()) do
        if teacher:IsA("Model") then
            local teacherRoot = teacher:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if teacherRoot then
                local distance = (teacherRoot.Position - myPosition).Magnitude
                if distance > detentoin then continue end
                
                for _, sound in pairs(teacher:GetDescendants()) do
                    if sound.Name == "SwingSFX" and checkSoundPlaying(sound) then
                        pressQ()
                        return
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
end

local function startLoop()
    if connection then
        connection:Disconnect()
    end
    
    connection = game:GetService("RunService").Heartbeat:Connect(function()
        if enabled then
            checkForSwing()
        end
    end)
end

local function onCharacterAdded(newCharacter)
    character = newCharacter
    humanoidRootPart = newCharacter:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")
end

player.CharacterAdded:Connect(onCharacterAdded)

local function onInputBegan(input, gameProcessed)
    if gameProcessed then return end
    if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.J then
        enabled = not enabled
    end
end

UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(onInputBegan)

startLoop()
